services.label: What we do
services.title: End-to-end software services
services.description: Whether you need a new product, a rescue for an existing one or an expert second opinion, we cover the full lifecycle.

web.title: Web application development
web.description: Custom web apps, portals, marketplaces and internal tools, built with modern, maintainable stacks and a focus on performance.

mobile.title: Mobile and cross-platform apps
mobile.description: Responsive, app-like experiences that work smoothly on every device, from the first prototype to a polished release.

design.title: Product and UX design
design.description: Research-informed user flows, interface design and design systems that turn business goals into products people enjoy using.

cloud.title: Cloud and DevOps
cloud.description: Cloud setup, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring so your product ships often, scales safely and stays online.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.description: Architecture reviews, technology selection, code audits and roadmap planning to help you make the right call before you build.

support.title: Maintenance and support
support.description: Ongoing improvements, bug fixes and performance tuning, so your software keeps delivering value after launch.

process.label: How we work
process.title: A clear process from idea to launch
process.description: Five predictable steps, regular demos and no surprises.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: We learn your business, users and constraints, then define goals, scope and success measures together.

design.title: Design
design.description: We map user journeys, prototype the key screens and agree on architecture before writing production code.

build.title: Build
build.description: We develop in short iterations with working demos, code reviews and automated checks along the way.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: We test, optimise and release with a clear rollout plan, then hand over documentation and access.

support.title: Support
support.description: We monitor, maintain and evolve the product as your users and your business grow.

projects.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
projects.answer: We build web platforms, marketplaces, dashboards, internal tools and customer portals, and we advise teams on architecture, technology choices and delivery. If you are unsure whether we are the right fit, tell us about your goals and we will say so honestly.

timeline.question: How long does it take to build an MVP?
timeline.answer: It depends on scope. After a discovery call we agree on a prioritised feature set and give you a realistic timeline, typically measured in weeks rather than months for a focused MVP.

pricing.question: How do you price your work?
pricing.answer: We offer fixed-scope pricing for well-defined work and time-and-materials for evolving products. After the discovery call we recommend the model that fits your situation and share a clear estimate.

existing.question: Can you work with our existing codebase or team?
existing.answer: Yes. We regularly join existing products and teams to audit code, add features, improve performance and pay down technical debt, and we follow your conventions and workflow.

afterLaunch.question: What happens after launch?
afterLaunch.answer: We can stay on for monitoring, maintenance and new features, or hand everything over with documentation so your team can take it from there.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's build something together
contact.description: Tell us about your product, your challenge or your idea. We will get back to you promptly with next steps.

about.label: About us
about.title: A software studio built on senior engineering
about.description: Vincent Studio Company designs, builds and supports software for startups and growing businesses. We combine more than a decade of hands-on engineering with a simple belief: good software comes from understanding the business first, then choosing the simplest technology that solves the problem.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Vincent Le
founder.note: With over 12 years of experience in full-stack web development, I have worked on everything from large international platforms to products I built and launched on my own. I started Vincent Studio Company to bring that experience to teams that want a reliable technical partner. I enjoy solving design challenges with clean code and great UX, and I care about building interfaces that work flawlessly and bring joy to the people who use them.

quality.title: Quality you can see
quality.description: Clean code, accessible interfaces and careful details, because users notice.

clarity.title: Clarity over jargon
clarity.description: Plain-language proposals, honest estimates and decisions explained, not hidden.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: We treat your product as our own and flag risks early instead of waiting to be asked.

partnership.title: Long-term partnership
partnership.description: We aim to be the technical team you want to keep working with after launch.

stack.description: We choose technology to fit your product, not the other way round. These are some of the tools we use most.
